meta.title: Rc<T>: A Lease That Ends When the Last Tenant Leaves

cards.title: Rc counts, doesn't garbage-collect
items: Every clone() increments a count; every drop decrements it
The value is freed the instant the count reaches zero — no tracing, no pause

cards.title: Rc<RefCell<T>> for shared mutation
items: Rc alone only gives shared read access
Wrap the inner value in RefCell to mutate through a shared Rc, checked at runtime
